chapter: Road bands: Hucklebuck Williams and Tiny Bradshaw
title: Getting high on a gig and walking off the stand
summary: A club owner gives Sam marijuana and he is too high to play, walking off the stand; the leaders suspect a heavy drug habit.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: youngest dude in the band. So, so I'm setting in my seat in the bus. I'm--I stayed to myself very much. I didn't say nothing to too much in the band, you know that. So, we get to a town in Alabama somewhere--playing at at--at a one-nighter at a club there. And the guy that ran the club was a young dude. He was a young guy, you know.

So, man, when we got there, man, me and this guy, we hit it right off, man. Cause he looked at me and I looked at him, man and say damn. I'm saying to myself, saying damn, this is the--this guy, you know, running this club. And he--he tells me, he say to himself, damn, this young dude playing in this band here. So we hit it right off, man.

So we came up and say, hey man, and shook hands. And time I got the time he say "come go with me, man." So we got in the car. And so he say "you smoke?" And I say "yeah," you know. And so he reaches in the glove compartment and pulled out some, some, some uh, some smoke. We got high and stuff. So we played that night, you know. And the next day when we were leaving, he said to me, he said "hey, look, man." He gave me a package, you know. He said "take this with you on the road." He said, he said "I know you're going to need it out here," you know. Say "yeah, man." So, in fact, we got so tight, man, til him
and his buddies followed us out of the town, you know. Followed the bus out of town. But that was some powerful, powerful, man, that smoke.

Either that or my resistance was down. And so we got to the next town down in Georgia somewhere. I don't know where we was, man, down in them swamps. I smoked a joint on the bus just before going in. You know half a joint, just before going inside the dance hall, you know.
And--and when I got in there and picked up the bass, man, I felt myself getting high. So ossified that all of a sudden I can't even play--play the bass, man.

And I saw all the guys in the band looking at me, man, checking me out. And so I just laid the bass down, man, and walked straight off the bandstand and went and got in the bus. When I woke up, I felt myself moving and the bus--we was on the highway, man. I ain't even played the dance. So now, the manager and Paul, they got their heads together up in front. They think that I'm a--that I've been--I was a--I was a heavy drug user.
And they had wrote my notice out, you see.
And they was trying to figure out where can they send me back--the point where they can send me back to Florida.
The don't want to be bothered with no drug--no drug addict and stuff.
